examples.arabic: أمي بتقولي إن اختيار الفستان زي اختيار رئيس الجمهورية صعب
examples.english: My mom tells me that choosing the dress is as difficult as choosing the President of the Republic.
examples.transliteration: Ommi betʾūli en ekhtiyār el-fostān zayy ekhtiyār raʾīs el-gomhūrīya ṣaʿb.

examples.arabic: اشترينا فستان ابيض جميل اوي للعروسة
examples.english: We bought a very beautiful white dress for the bride.
examples.transliteration: eshtareyna fostan abyad gameel awy lel arosa

examples.english: The wedding is big and the dress is pretty

examples.arabic: اشترينا لها فستان حلو لونه كحلي عشان هي بتحب الوان غامقة
examples.english: We bought her a nice dress, its color is navy blue, because she likes dark colors.
examples.transliteration: eshtareyna laha fostaan helw lono kohli ashan heyya betheb alwaan ghamqa

examples.arabic: انا رايحه اشتري حاجات من السوق بس كان لازم ارجع الفستان و كنت زعلانه
examples.english: I am going to buy some things from the market but I had to return the dress and I was sad.
examples.transliteration: ana rayha ashtiri hagat min es souq bas kan lazem araggaa el fostan wa kont zaalana

examples.arabic: هي شافت فستان حلو اوي في محل صغير
examples.english: She saw a very nice dress in a small shop.
examples.transliteration: Heyya shafet fostan helw awi fi mahal soghayyar.
